text: Instance.get() inside virtual thread loses request scope
Thread.sleep(300) flaky test for virtual thread completion

detail: No end-to-end test verifying a worker invocation receives prior case reasoning in context. PrReviewReasoningEnrichmentTest only validates YAML config fields; the full devtown->AgentMemoryRetriever->worker context chain is untested end-to-end.
FailureClass enum and WorkerOutcome.Failed.hint field added with no consumer in this branch. No engine handler, devtown resolver, or test reads the hint. Adds API surface with zero current behavior.

"worker-reasoning" domain name constructed independently in devtown resolvers instead of referencing AgentExperienceRecorder.WORKER_REASONING_DOMAIN or a shared constant. DevtownModelEnricher also hardcodes the same string.

Two distinct representations of reasoning data in devtown: ReasoningTrace record (full trace) in ReasoningQueryResolver and embedded String in PriorDecision. Both query the same worker-reasoning domain by caseId+capability; callers must choose between them.
extractCapabilityTag() is duplicated across both handlers with slightly different signatures. Should be a package-private shared helper in the handler package.
LOG.warnf() in the compact constructor adds side-effect logic to a data record. Validation/warning belongs at parse time (YAML mapper) or a startup health check.
extractCapabilityTag() called before contextOutputApplier.apply(); a registry exception would skip output application. Fixed in commit 327ca5b7 by isolating reasoning storage in try-catch.
storeReasoning() catch block only logs WARN with no counter increment; burst failures under load are undetectable without log scraping.
Migrate HealthSnapshot to HealthScoreSnapshot (#1168) (S / Low) [casehubio/engine] — Bridged internally by HealthScoreDeltaRegressionEvaluator — mechanical type migration, no architectural blocker
Wire RegressionDetector to RegressionEvaluatorRegistry (#1169) (S / Low) [casehubio/engine] — Registry and evaluator infrastructure exists and is tested — detector wiring depends on #1168
Remove targetRepo/targetPaths from ImprovementRequest (#1170) (M / Low) [casehubio/engine] — Backward-compatible constructor exists — ~27 call sites need mechanical update
